name: artifact-patterns
description: Chooses how a published Claude artifact and the people using it exchange information with a Claude session, and builds the matching page. Use when an artifact is meant for other people to act on: status or progress pages, dashboards, review or playtest feedback, votes, triage, sign-offs, a runbook or spec doc teammates edit, or "how will you notice when someone comments, flags, marks or edits it". Not for visual page design or the runtime capability API, which the artifact-capabilities skill owns.
